usedFor: StoreHippo holds your orders and Teamhood organizes the work, so “New Order” runs “Create Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Create Item” in Teamhood
bestTemplate.why: Each order becomes an item on your board, so fulfilment has a visible owner.

watchOut: “New Product Created” and “New User” also fit “Create Item”, so pick one trigger or the board fills fast.
